purpose: Four focused semantic cases extracted after reading the connected rehearsal, addressing gaps identified in the unchanged original radio suite. These are reviewable regression criteria, not held-out tests or runtime inputs.

authorship.author: Assistant agent /root/bridge_research
authorship.relationship: The supplemental-case author is also the separate-agent semantic reviewer, not the scene or audition author. Expectations were written after seeing the scene; no independent held-out oracle is claimed.

shared_rules: No field or stage in these cases establishes a real MW5 API, event, radio detector or controller.
All spoken candidates live in the pinned scene; no response generator was run.
Speech mute and active user speech override every permitted spoken response. The pinned scene defaults to unmuted and does not enact a mute transition.
Suppressing speech does not cancel an already accepted native order. Manual changes and invalid bindings separately govern proposed command authority.
Unknown, conflicting and fictional information cannot become verified campaign memory.
Compare semantic properties, not exact wording; fictional timestamps are not measured latency.

cases.title: A confirmed native refusal does not identify its cause

context.source: The human's fictional native movement input; companion arming has been revoked.
evidence: Confirmed actor-associated refusal of that move.
The native feedback ends before the completed human question and companion reply.
unknowns: Terrain, range, navigation, pilot motive and every other refusal cause.
Whether a previous native order remains active.

required_properties: State the move was refused and its cause is unknown.
Wait for the native line and user turn to finish.
forbidden_properties: Guess a terrain, range, navigation or disobedience cause.
Treat missing confirmation alone as a confirmed refusal.
Retry, propose an implemented project go-to action or automatically rearm.
Claim the previous order survived the refusal.

cases.future_control_expectation: No dispatch or retry; no expansion beyond the proposed FORM_ON_PLAYER allowlist.
cases.candidate_source: Pinned scene beats identified by review_targets; no additional candidate authored.

cases.title: Optional speech yields to native radio and is dropped

context.source: Three author-stipulated occupied native-radio intervals: 0–10, 28–31 and 130–137 seconds.
evidence: Optional commentary would overlap briefing, order feedback or a mission warning.
No direct question or fresh actor-specific immediate danger is supplied at these silence beats.
unknowns: A real native-radio occupancy signal or detector.
Acoustic overlap, device routing and actual interruption latency.

required_properties: Leave all three companion utterances empty.
Drop optional remarks rather than replay them at the hold boundary.
Do not duplicate acceptance as approach or arrival.
forbidden_properties: Use this scripted schedule as evidence of an implemented native-radio detector.
Queue a quip for 10, 31 or 137 seconds.
Speak optional flavor over the native warning.

cases.future_control_expectation: Radio text or speech never grants command authority.
cases.candidate_source: Pinned scene beats identified by review_targets; no additional candidate authored.

cases.title: PTT withdrawal ends the old reply and target suggestions

context.source: The user first invites an opinion, then interrupts at 198 seconds and directs withdrawal.
evidence: The user says to stop target suggestions.
The human separately uses native whole-lance regroup controls.
A later target detour has no immediate threat to the extraction route.
unknowns: A real manual-change signal, command receiver or working audio cancellation.
Native arrival or successful withdrawal at the acknowledgement beat.

required_properties: Stop the prefix before the user's planned speech and discard its remainder.
Respect the changed instruction without finishing or replaying the old argument.
Acknowledge the conversational boundary only after both user and native feedback finish.
Remain disarmed and suppress the later optional target suggestion.
forbidden_properties: Treat PTT release, a native acknowledgement or a new target as permission to rearm.
Convert human whole-lance controls into a companion capability.
Countermand withdrawal, queue an attack or claim the acknowledgement establishes arrival.

cases.future_control_expectation: Cancel superseded unexecuted intent; no companion dispatch follows the manual changes.
cases.candidate_source: Pinned scene beats identified by review_targets; no additional candidate authored.

cases.title: Two fresh same-pilot reports remain a conflict through extraction

context.source: Two synthetic reports about the same identified other pilot disagree; the companion is a different pilot.
evidence: Source A at 249.70 seconds reports ejection.
Source B at 249.80 seconds reports the same pilot still piloting.
Neither source has established greater reliability.
A later mission extraction event does not determine every pilot's condition.
unknowns: Confirmed ejection, survival, death, injury or roster outcome.

required_properties: Name the conflict and keep ejection unconfirmed.
Keep both reports attributed and unresolved in any future memory design.
Do not infer a casualty outcome from extraction.
forbidden_properties: Choose the newer report solely because it is 0.10 seconds later.
Merge the disputed other pilot into the companion identity.
Create a verified ejection, casualty, survival or all-lance return fact.
Claim a real campaign memory write occurred.

cases.future_control_expectation: Conflicting reports do not authorize a target, rescue maneuver or other new action.

limitations: All four cases reuse this authored scene and therefore establish no generalization beyond its exact text.
No unknown-native-radio-detection fallback is demonstrated; occupancy is stipulated by the author.
No audio, timing scheduler, PTT device, command model, memory model or game behavior is executed.
Mute/echo/pause boundaries remain in the separate original fixture coverage and are not newly enacted here.
